verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Exa returns ranked results (exa-docs-60) and highlights sized to relevance (exa-docs-36), but no documented per-result relevance score field that a developer can read and threshold on. The result schema excerpt (exa-docs-37) lists publishedDate, author, summary and subpages, with no score. Ranking order, relevance-sized excerpts and Websets criteria verification are adjacent features, not readable scores.
